description:
Start a paid Wan 3.0 Prime video (POST /api/v1/higgsfield/wan-prime/generate).

Needs prompt. duration is 2-30 seconds; resolution 480p, 720p (default) or 1080p; aspect_ratio
16:9, 4:3, 1:1, 3:4, 9:16 or adaptive; generate_audio (default true); enable_thinking makes the
model plan the scene first (same price); optional seed. The input picks the mode: no files is
text to video; image_url (the first frame, optionally with end_image_url) is image to video;
image_urls (up to 10), video_urls (up to 5, 30 s together, each at least 1 s) and audio_urls
(up to 5, WAV or MP3, 30 s together) are reference to video. Frames and references cannot be
combined. Each file is a public HTTPS URL or the key/url returned by upload_media. Run
estimate_higgsfield_wan_prime first and pass its cost_rub as max_cost_rub to refuse a changed
price. Optional webhook_url (public HTTPS) is called when the video completes or fails;
otherwise follow the job with get_video. While it is still queued cancel_higgsfield_video
cancels it and refunds the charge.
name: create_higgsfield_wan_prime
